shared_or_similar_visual_information: A small circular arc placed between two rays at their common vertex.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It singles out the angle at A denoted by theta. Right image: It selects the vertex angle at P denoted by p.
Rationales: Each small arc selects a particular vertex angle and connects it to the nearby angle label or to the marked-angle relation. The target is that angle-selection convention, not equality of all labeled angle values.
